research.applicability: An authorized request calls for evidence, supported findings, success criteria, or identified evidence gaps. Can finish without Plan or Build.

plan.applicability: The requested outcome is an actionable, read-only Plan using the original request, accepted decisions, and sufficiently supported evidence. Research is optional when evidence is already sufficient.

build.applicability: The request names an existing Plan and its separately authorized execution scope. A Plan document or this template cannot grant execution permission.
